sceneCopy.investigation: Examine the three markers in the harbor. Open Cognitive Perception to see my reconstruction. We’ll keep the measurements separate from the possibilities.
sceneCopy.synthesis: Three readings. An engineered shape, a little warmth, and a map that never saw deep enough. Enough to ask a better question.
sceneCopy.surveyCompletion: A careful beginning. A living harbor. A mystery with room to breathe.
sceneCopy.handshakeCompletion: A faint light. An open possibility. Your first shared observation.
sceneCopy.footer: Take your time. The city will wait.
sceneCopy.emptyNotes: The harbor is still an open question.
sceneCopy.notesSubtitle: A record of what we know. And what we don’t.

clues.title: A shape under the water
clues.subtitle: Sonar geometry · maintenance float

observation.label: Observed · sonar returns
observation.detail: Repeated sonar passes reveal parallel ribs beneath sediment. Their far ends remain hidden; the scan cannot establish the material or the structure’s age.

model.label: Modeled · structural fit
model.detail: The spacing fits a support frame. Similar bracing appears in old harbor foundations and modern reef supports; the partial scan fits either.

clues.contradiction: This shape could be old or recent. Its geometry cannot date it or connect it to the Unbinding.

clues.title: A little warmth
clues.subtitle: Temperature transect · water sampling

observation.label: Observed · temperature probes
observation.detail: Two sampling passes find warmer water near the frame. Changing currents prevent us from identifying where the heat came from.

model.label: Modeled · heat transport
model.detail: A flow model allows waste heat, sediment chemistry, or warm outfall water. More temperature and current measurements could separate these sources.

clues.contradiction: Warm water alone cannot tell us whether the frame uses power or contains anything alive.

clues.title: The missing depth
clues.subtitle: Public archive · first post-Unbinding survey

observation.label: Observed · archived survey
observation.detail: The first post-Unbinding survey recorded open water here. Its instrument could only measure down to nine meters above the frame.

model.label: Modeled · historical inference
model.detail: The frame could have been below the survey’s reach, or arrived later. This record gives us no direct link to the Unbinding.

clues.contradiction: The map and sonar cover different depths. The old survey never looked where the frame lies.
